subject: Proposal & PO: Redwood Inference for Aegis Health — terms and redlines
messages:
From: Sarah Bloom <sarah.bloom@aegishealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Erickson <terickson@aegishealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal and PO attached — request on cap and warranty

Marcus — thanks for the demo last week. Attached is a PO + our redlines to the MSA and SOW. Two items that are blockers for our procurement/legal team: 1) Aegis requests a liability cap of $10,000,000 (we typically insist on product/aggregate caps at this level for enterprise patient-data workloads) and 2) a 12-month warranty for availability/accuracy commitments plus an indemnity that covers third-party IP claims without carveouts.

We're prepared to move forward quickly and submit an executed PO by end of week if Redwood can accept these points or provide an alternative mitigant (eg escrow, SLAs with credits, or an enhanced insurance certificate). I'm looping Tom (legal) and our procurement alias.

Attachments: Aegis_SOW_v3_redline.docx; Aegis_MSA_redline.pdf; proposal-Aegis-20261115.xlsx

Thanks,
Sarah Bloom
Director, Vendor Management
Aegis Health
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Bloom <sarah.bloom@aegishealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal and PO attached — request on cap and warranty

Sarah — appreciate the thorough redlines and the clear path to a PO. I'm reviewing with Legal and Sales Ops now. Quick note on the two asks: the $10M cap and broad third-party-indemnity are outside our standard risk profile. Proposed near-term options we can escalate for exec consideration: 1) increase cap to a one-time $5M (with an additional insurance certificate) or 2) keep standard $2M cap but add an escrow/short-term holdback tied to onboarding milestones. On warranty, a 12-month blanket warranty for availability/accuracy is unusual — we can offer clarified service levels with credits and a targeted warranty tied to SOW deliverables.

Looping Laura (Legal) and Vivek (Sales Ops) to advise on executive escalation steps and signoff thresholds. Can you confirm timeline for PO? If Aegis can sign by Friday, I'll prioritize this.

Best,
Marcus
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal and PO attached — request on cap and warranty

Marcus — reviewed the redlines and the attached MSA. Summary of legal posture: Aegis' requested language is high risk in three areas. 1) Indemnity: their version is uncapped for third-party IP and broadens obligations to indirect claims — we cannot accept as written. 2) Liability cap: $10M exceeds our standard commercial cap ($2M aggregate); raising to $5M is a material risk and requires executive authorization. 3) Warranty: 12 months of performance warranty for "accuracy" is too vague and exposes us to open-ended remediation.

If we escalate to an executive for signoff, request the following mitigations be presented with the ask: - Proposed capped alternative (we can offer $5M for twelve months only if Aegis accepts an expanded insurance certificate naming Redwood as insured and a narrow IP carveout), - For indemnity: carve out Redwood's liability for downstream patient harm (we'll accept indemnity for IP and data breach where Redwood is negligent), - For warranty: replace with defined SLAs in SOW (uptime, incident response, accuracy thresholds tied to labeled datasets) and limit warranty remedies to service credits and reversal of charges.

I've attached annotated redlines (Aegis_MSA_redline.pdf) and a short memo for the exec that states residual risk. If you want, I'll prepare a one-page risk memo for Ben (Head of Sales) and the CFO with recommended approval limits.

--Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Proposal and PO attached — request on cap and warranty (exec approval requested)

Ben — forwarding an incoming deal from Aegis Health (see attachments). ARR: ~$1.2M first-year ARR, net-new commercial account, strategic healthcare reference. The customer is requesting non-standard liability/indemnity/warranty terms that Legal flags as high risk. Laura recommends executive approval if we move beyond our standard $2M cap. Options to approve: (A) Approve up to a $5M aggregate cap for 12 months provided Aegis accepts enhanced insurance and IP carveouts; (B) Approve standard $2M cap and offer a 15% discount and tighter SLA/warranty language; (C) Decline and hold to standard MSA. Also note Aegis is pressing for a 20% discount tied to a 3-year commit.

I need a quick decision to keep momentum — they can sign this week if we can close on terms. Laura will prepare a one-pager for execs if you want formal signoff language.

Thanks,
Marcus
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposal and PO attached — request on cap and warranty (exec approval requested)

Marcus / Laura / Vivek — quick decision from my side given deal size and strategic value: approve a near-term concession set to accelerate close, subject to Legal implementing the mitigations below and Finance signing off on discount impact. Approved items: 1) Liability cap increase to $5,000,000 (aggregate) for the initial 12-month term only; 2) Discount: up to 15% (not 20%) for a 3-year term with standard renewal pricing thereafter; 3) Indemnity: accept IP indemnity but require clear IP carveouts (no downstream patient harm indemnity) and require Aegis to add Redwood as an additional insured on their cyber liability policy with $5M limits; 4) Warranty: replace broad 12-month warranty with SOW-defined SLAs and service credits as sole remedy.

Laura: please produce an exec signoff letter for the approval (one page) and update the MSA redline accordingly — include the insurance certificate language and the limited 12-month cap only tied to initial term. Vivek: update the quote in HubSpot and lock discount field to 15% max; Finance, please confirm no additional approvals required. Marcus: communicate these constraints back to Sarah and ask them to confirm acceptance by EOD Friday if possible.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
